title: Climbing Silver
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 4 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: T,N,C are integers.; 1 \le T \le 50000; 2 \le N \le 3000; 1 \le C \le N; S_i is a string of length N consisting of . and #.; The C-th character of S_N is ..; For each input, the sum of N^2 does not exceed 9 \times 10^6.
